quote: We explore converting dialogues into a universal code-like format to represent reply dependency structures between utterances... We conduct experiments on the public DiaASQ benchmark dataset.
Dialogue Aspect-based Sentiment Quadruple (Di-aASQ) is a newly-emergent task aiming to extract the sentiment quadruple (i.e., targets, aspects, opinions, and sentiments) from conversations
outputs: sentiment quadruples (targets, aspects, opinions, sentiments) and structured dialogue dependency representations

quote: Following previous work, we mainly measure the performances in terms of four angles: span match [...] through precision, recall, and F1 score metrics.
We mainly measure the performances in terms of ... precision, recall, and F1 score metrics.

We mainly measure the performances in terms of four angles: span match (i.e., Target, Aspect, and Opinion), pair extraction (i.e., Target-Aspect, Aspect-Opinion, and Target-Opinion), triplet detection (i.e., Target-Aspect-Opinion), quadruple extraction (i.e., Target-Aspect-Opinion-Sentiment), and non-opinion detection through precision, recall, and F1 score metrics.
we conduct comparative experiments with ChatGPT-4 4shot and ChatGLM3 LoRA
